strings.error.calendar_duplicate: This assistant already watches that calendar.
strings.error.calendar_time_invalid: Write the time as hours and minutes, for example 19:00, or leave it empty.
strings.error.chat_agent_failed: An assistant could not write its next line, so the chat ended.
strings.error.chat_bad_speaker: That speaker cannot be used. Choose a satellite that can announce or a media player that can play media.
strings.error.chat_character_too_long: The character for chats may be 2000 characters at most. Shorten it.
strings.error.chat_done: The chat reached its line limit.
strings.error.chat_failed: The chat stopped because of an unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has the details.
strings.error.chat_limits_invalid: The chat limits are not valid: {reason}
strings.error.chat_no_router: One of the chosen assistants is not available. Reload the page and choose again.
strings.error.chat_no_writer: Both assistants need an announcement agent without tools before they can chat. Choose one under Reminders in each assistant's settings.
strings.error.chat_running: A chat is already running. Stop it first.
strings.error.chat_same_assistant: Choose two different assistants for the chat.
strings.error.chat_speaker_busy: The speaker stayed busy, so the chat ended.
strings.error.chat_speaker_failed: The speaker could not play a line, so the chat ended.
strings.error.chat_time_up: The chat reached its time limit.
strings.error.favorites_bad_kind: Choose what kind of favorite this is: radio, podcast, playlist, album, track or stream.
strings.error.favorites_bad_name: A name needs a letter or digit and may be 80 characters at most.
strings.error.favorites_bad_override: A satellite's speaker must be a media player. Choose one again.
strings.error.favorites_bad_uri: That Music Assistant item cannot be saved. Search for it again.
strings.error.favorites_bad_url: An address must start with http:// or https:// (an image may also be a path on Home Assistant starting with /), have no spaces and be 2000 characters at most.
strings.error.favorites_name_taken: That name is already used in this list. Choose another name.
strings.error.favorites_no_music_assistant: Searching needs Music Assistant, which is not set up. Add the favorite with a stream address instead.
strings.error.favorites_no_source: A favorite needs either a Music Assistant item or a stream address.
strings.error.favorites_not_found: That favorite is not in the list any more. Reload the page.
strings.error.favorites_nothing_found: Music Assistant found nothing by that name. Try another name.
strings.error.favorites_search_failed: Music Assistant could not search just now. Try again later, or add the favorite with a stream address.
strings.error.favorites_too_many: A list may hold 100 favorites at most. Remove one first.
strings.error.favorites_too_many_aliases: A favorite may have 5 other names at most.
strings.error.guide_names_missing: Both person names are needed to tell the speakers apart.
strings.error.guide_names_same: The two people need different names in the voice match, or the assistant cannot tell them apart.
strings.error.guide_no_pipeline: That wake word does not use a pipeline that can be copied.
strings.error.guide_no_satellite: That satellite was not found. Reload the page and try again.
strings.error.guide_no_sensors: This satellite has no speaker sensors yet. Set up voice matching for it first.
strings.error.guide_not_wake_word: That is not a wake word of one of your satellites.
strings.error.guide_pipeline_name_shared: Two pipelines are named {name}, so the wake word could end up on the wrong one. Rename one of them in Settings > Voice assistants, then try again.
strings.error.guide_pipeline_not_router: That pipeline does not use this assistant, so it was left alone.
strings.error.guide_router_missing: This assistant is not ready yet. Reload it and try again.
strings.error.guide_tracked: An automation already uses this satellite's speaker sensors, so nothing was created.
strings.error.line_too_long: A fact may be 200 characters at most. This line is too long: {line}
strings.error.memory_agent_invalid: The agent that decides what to save may not be the main agent, another assistant or an agent that can control the home, and it must exist. Pick an agent without tools.
strings.error.memory_agent_required: Choose an agent that decides what to save, or turn memory off.
strings.error.mine_cannot_delete: This reminder cannot be deleted. It may be gone already, or its calendar does not allow deleting.
strings.error.mine_failed: Home Assistant could not do this. The reason is in its log.
strings.error.mine_favorites_conflict: Your favorites are not shared until every assistant agrees who you are; ask an administrator.
strings.error.mine_favorites_not_linked: Favorites are kept for the people of an assistant. Ask an administrator to choose your Home Assistant user under People on the Voice Manager page.
strings.error.mine_favorites_off: Favorites are off for your assistants. Ask an administrator to switch them on.
strings.error.mine_no_name: A reminder for you needs your name, and none is set yet. Ask an administrator to fill in your name under People on the Voice Manager page, or add the reminder for the household.
strings.error.mine_no_script: Reminders cannot be added yet, because the script script.create_reminder does not exist. Ask an administrator to set it up.
strings.error.mine_not_yours: That is not one of your assistants.
strings.error.mine_persona_too_long: Your persona may be 2000 characters at most. Shorten it and try again.
strings.error.mine_scope_invalid: Choose whether the reminder is for you or for the household.
strings.error.mine_settings_need_admin: Your persona cannot be saved until an administrator fixes this assistant's other settings on the Voice Manager page. Ask an administrator to open that page.
strings.error.mine_time_invalid: Choose either a number of minutes from now (1 or more) or a time such as 19:30. A day can only go with a time.
strings.error.mine_title_invalid: Write what to be reminded of, in 200 characters at most.
strings.error.refusal_agent_invalid: The agent that writes refusals may not be another assistant or an agent that can control the home, and it must exist. Pick an agent without tools, so an unknown voice can never reach one.
strings.error.reminder_agent_invalid: The agent that writes spoken announcements may not be the main agent, another assistant or an agent that can control the home, and it must exist. Pick an agent without tools.
strings.error.reminder_calendar_no_user: Personal reminder calendars need a Home Assistant user for that person, so My assistant knows whose they are. Choose the user under People, or empty the list.
strings.error.reminder_calendar_shared: {calendar} cannot be a reminder calendar here: {router} already uses it for someone else or for the household. A personal calendar belongs to one person and is never also a household one.
strings.error.reminder_calendar_twice: {calendar} is chosen twice in this assistant's reminder calendars. A personal calendar belongs to one person and is never also a household one.
strings.error.same_user: Person 1 and Person 2 cannot have the same Home Assistant user.
strings.error.too_many_facts: A list may hold 200 facts at most. Remove some facts and try again.
strings.mine.favorites.aliases_help: Separated by commas, 5 at most. Asking for any of them plays this favorite.
strings.mine.favorites.aliases_placeholder: For example: the news, morning radio
strings.mine.favorites.conflict: Your favorites are not shared until every assistant agrees who you are. Ask an administrator.
strings.mine.favorites.lede: Radio stations, podcasts and playlists you can ask for by name, for example: play Radio 2. They are the same on all your assistants, and changes are saved at once.
strings.mine.favorites.name: Name
strings.mine.favorites.off: Favorites are off for your assistants. Ask an administrator to switch them on.
strings.mine.favorites.url_help: An http:// or https:// address that plays the stream itself.
strings.mine.memory.add_placeholder: Add a fact, for example: prefers tea in the evening
strings.mine.memory.lede: What {title} remembers about you. Changes are saved at once. A private fact is kept from the other person.
strings.mine.memory.none: There is nothing remembered for you on this assistant.
strings.mine.memory.private_help: Kept from the other person. Select to share it.
strings.mine.memory.shared_help: The other person's assistant may use it too. Select to keep it private.
strings.mine.persona.label: Your persona
strings.mine.persona.lede: How {title} talks to you. This text is added to its instructions whenever you speak.
strings.mine.persona.placeholder: For example: the person speaking is Alex. Keep answers short.
strings.mine.reminders.announce: Speak it when it is due
strings.mine.reminders.announce_help: The assistant says it aloud on the satellite when it is due.
strings.mine.reminders.calendars_note: Everyone in the household can still see all calendars on Home Assistant's own Calendar page. This page shows only yours and the household's.
strings.mine.reminders.cannot_delete: Its calendar does not allow deleting.
strings.mine.reminders.empty: No reminders in the next 30 days.
strings.mine.reminders.lede: Your own reminders and the household's, for the next 30 days.
strings.mine.reminders.no_script: Reminders cannot be added here yet: an administrator needs to set up the create_reminder script.
strings.mine.reminders.unreadable: This calendar could not be read: {calendar}
strings.mine.shared.all_day_before: all-day events at {time} the day before
strings.mine.shared.all_day_usual: all-day events at the usual time
strings.mine.shared.all_day_usual_before: all-day events at the usual time the day before
strings.mine.shared.assistant_help: The name reminders are taken under, and the voice they are spoken in.
strings.mine.shared.calendars_none: No calendar is announced for you or for everyone.
strings.mine.shared.lede: Set by an administrator for the whole household. Shown here so you know how it works.
strings.mine.shared.strangers_ai: Turned away politely, in words written by an agent that cannot control the home.
strings.mine.title: My assistant
strings.mine.unlinked: You are not linked to an assistant yet. Ask an administrator to open the Voice Manager page, go to People, and choose you as the Home Assistant user of Person 1 or Person 2.
